verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same, and both have the same flaws. The pillow photo has shrunk to a small strip, so the hero image no longer matters. The light-blue highlight behind 'HOUSE' is gone, and two pale blue bars sit loose at the top with no purpose. The body copy is nearly as big as the headline, which flattens the hierarchy. There are big dead gaps between the text, the photo and the contact box, and the space under the contact box is empty. A edges ahead only because its stack sits a little lower, leaving less empty space at the bottom than B, which is pushed up and more bottom-heavy in empty space.
